tagline: Japan again, miles and lounges, and where everyone's going next.
why: Hong Kongers are some of the world's most frequent travellers, and 'where are you going next?' is a reliable conversation starter. Travel talk covers favourite destinations, airlines, points and miles, hotels and hidden gems. Knowing the popular spots, the travel-hacking vocabulary and the current trends lets you trade tips and stories with anyone.

essentials.title: Hong Kong's favourite destinations
essentials.body: Japan by far, then Korea, Taiwan, Thailand, mainland China (Shenzhen, Guangzhou, Shanghai), Singapore and Europe for longer trips.

essentials.title: Short trips are normal
essentials.body: Long weekends in Japan or Taiwan, and day trips to Shenzhen or Macau, are a big part of local travel culture.

essentials.title: Miles and points
essentials.body: Frequent flyers collect airline miles (Cathay's Asia Miles), hotel points and credit card points to get free flights and upgrades.

essentials.title: Airline alliances
essentials.body: Oneworld (Cathay Pacific, British Airways, Qantas, JAL), Star Alliance (Singapore Airlines, ANA, Lufthansa) and SkyTeam (Korean Air, Air France).

essentials.title: Travel styles
essentials.body: Luxury, budget backpacking, food trips, hiking and ski trips, city breaks and cruises. People identify with a style.

essentials.title: Seasons matter
essentials.body: Cherry blossoms in Japan (late March-April), autumn leaves (November), ski season (December-March), and avoiding typhoon season.

names.name: Cathay Pacific
names.what: Hong Kong's flagship airline, recovering strongly after Covid.

names.name: HK Express
names.what: Hong Kong's budget airline, owned by Cathay.

names.name: Hong Kong International Airport
names.what: Consistently one of the world's best airports; its third runway opened in 2024.

names.name: Japan
names.what: Hong Kong's number one destination, from Tokyo and Osaka to Hokkaido and Kyushu.

names.name: Taiwan
names.what: A favourite for food, night markets and short trips.

names.name: Korea
names.what: Seoul for shopping, food and K-culture.

names.name: Thailand
names.what: Bangkok, Phuket and Chiang Mai for beaches, food and value.

names.name: Shenzhen
names.what: Just across the border, now a weekend destination for shopping, food and massages.

names.name: Macau
names.what: An hour away by ferry or bridge: casinos, Portuguese food and egg tarts.

names.name: Singapore Airlines
names.what: Often ranked the world's best airline.

names.name: Booking.com / Trip.com / Klook
names.what: Popular booking platforms; Klook is Hong Kong-founded.

names.name: Skytrax
names.what: Organisation that ranks airlines and airports.

timeline.event: Kai Tak airport closes; Chek Lap Kok opens.
High-speed rail to the mainland and the Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge open.
Covid stops travel; Hong Kong's quarantine rules last until late 2022.
The airport's three-runway system opens; Japan sees record visitors.
Japan and Korea break tourism records; China expands visa-free entry.

now.headline: Japan overload
now.detail: Japan is hugely popular thanks to the weak yen; some places now charge tourist taxes or limit crowds.

now.headline: Shenzhen weekends
now.detail: Cheap, trendy and close: Hong Kongers go north for food, shopping and Sam's Club runs.

now.headline: Visa-free China
now.detail: Mainland China opened visa-free entry to many countries, boosting tourism.

now.headline: Points game
now.detail: Credit card and airline points are a hobby for many people.

now.headline: Hot destinations
now.detail: Kyushu, Hokkaido, Chiang Mai, Vietnam's Da Nang and Central Asia are trending.

local.headline: Holiday planning
local.detail: Hong Kongers plan trips around public holidays and long weekends; flights to Japan sell out fast.

local.headline: Cathay vs budget
local.detail: People debate Cathay's comfort vs HK Express's price.

local.headline: Airport Express
local.detail: In-town check-in at Hong Kong and Kowloon stations is a beloved convenience.

local.headline: Greater Bay Area
local.detail: Trains and the bridge make Guangzhou, Zhuhai and Macau easy weekend trips.

debates.question: Is Japan too crowded now?
debates.sides: Still amazing vs too many tourists in popular spots.

debates.question: Business class: worth it?
debates.sides: Comfort on long flights vs huge price.

debates.question: Points: worth the effort?
debates.sides: Free flights vs the time spent optimising.
